name: Naruto Uzumaki [The Final Battle]
balanceNote: All damaging moves, indirect damage and counters use buffed Physical ATK against Physical DEF. All Ninjutsu growth is Physical ATK growth. Area attacks hit all enemies as requested. Kurama and the nine beasts are original visual skill actors, not independently targetable summons. Source descriptions do not specify numeric damage coefficients; chosen values are explicit below.

bond1.name: Tailed Beast Bond
bond1.description: Naruto resonates a Tailed Beast Power in the order of Shukaku, Matatabi, Isobu, Son Goku, Kokuo, Saiken, Chomei, Gyuki, Kurama. After every time Naruto resonates with a Tailed Beast, he can execute his Mystery skill again. After Naruto resonates with Kurama, his Mystery changes to Six Paths - Super Massive Rasen-Shuriken.

bond2.name: Tailed Beast Bond
bond2.description: Naruto activates Matatabi Resonance, dispels all Blindness he currently has. While having this Resonance, Naruto's Standard Attack causes Level 2 - Ignition. Lasts until the end of the round.

bond3.name: Tailed Beast Bond
bond3.description: Naruto activates Isobu Resonance, dispels all Blindness he currently has. While having this Resonance, Naruto's Standard Attack causes Discouragement. Lasts until the end of the round.

bond4.name: Tailed Beast Bond
bond4.description: Naruto activates Son Goku Resonance, dispels all Blindness he currently has. While having this Resonance, Naruto's Standard Attack causes Inferno. Lasts until the end of the round.

bond5.name: Tailed Beast Bond
bond5.description: Naruto activates Kokuo Resonance, dispels all Debuffs (including Level 2 Debuffs) he currently has. While having this Resonance, Naruto's Standard Attack causes Defense Shatter. Lasts until the end of the round.

bond6.name: Tailed Beast Bond
bond6.description: Naruto activates Saiken Resonance, dispels all Blindness he currently has. While having this Resonance, Naruto's Standard Attack causes Melt. Lasts until the end of the round.

bond7.name: Tailed Beast Bond
bond7.description: Naruto activates Chomei Resonance, dispels all Blindness he currently has. While having this Resonance, Naruto's Standard Attack causes Level 2 - Blindness. Lasts until the end of the round.

bond8.name: Tailed Beast Bond
bond8.description: Naruto activates Gyuki Resonance, dispels all Blindness he currently has. While having this Resonance, whenever Naruto's Standard Attack causes Knockdown, he also causes Dye Ink to that unit. Lasts until the end of the round.

bond9.name: Tailed Beast Bond
bond9.description: Naruto activates Kurama Resonance, dispels all Blindness he currently has. While having this Resonance, whenever Naruto's Standard Attack defeats a unit, he receives an Extra Standard Attack. Lasts until the end of the round.

standard.name: Kurama Power
standard.description: Naruto randomly executes Kurama Claw, Kurama Tail or Kurama - Tailed Beast Bomb as his Standard Attack.

tail.name: Kurama Power
tail.description: Naruto randomly executes Kurama Claw, Kurama Tail or Kurama - Tailed Beast Bomb as his Standard Attack.

bomb.name: Kurama Power
bomb.description: Attacks all units in the opponent's lineup and causes Suppress Immunity until the end of the next round, causes Knockdown to a unit hit. This skill neglects Shields and has additonal Critical Rate increase.

finalMystery.name: Six Paths - Super Massive Rasen-Shuriken
finalMystery.description: Causes unavoidable damage neglecting Shields to all units in the opponent's field, causes Knockdown and Level 2 - Weakness for 1 round to the selected unit. If there's only 1 unit in the opponent's field, increase this skill's damage by 100%. If the selected unit is a Female unit, executes Sexy Jutsu - Reverse Harem Jutsu.

harem.name: Sexy Jutsu - Reverse Harem Jutsu
harem.description: Causes Interruption, Level 2 - Slowness to the selected unit and reduces that unit's damage caused by 60% (not stackable), last until the end of the round. This skill is unavoidable.

chase.name: Sage Art - Magnet Style Rasengan
chase.description: Chases and Attacks a Low Floated or Knocked Down unit, causes Repulse and Magnet Seal. This skill is unavoidable. If Naruto has Shukaku Resonance, this skill additionally ignores a certain amount of Defense and Resistance and Magnet Seal becomes a Special Effect.

additional.name: Tailed Beast Repeated Rasen-Shuriken
additional.description: Additional Skill: Causes unavoidable damage, Interruption and Suppress Super Armor for 1 round to all units in the opponent's field.

recovery.name: Six Paths - Recovery
recovery.description: Dispels all Debuffs and resets all actions. Recovers 10% of Naruto's max HP.

restoration.name: Six Paths - Restoration
restoration.description: Dispels all Debuffs and resets all actions. Recovers 10% of Naruto's max HP.

mystery.name: Tailed Beast Bond
mystery.description: Naruto resonates a Tailed Beast Power in the order of Shukaku, Matatabi, Isobu, Son Goku, Kokuo, Saiken, Chomei, Gyuki, Kurama. After every time Naruto resonates with a Tailed Beast, he can execute his Mystery skill again. After Naruto resonates with Kurama, his Mystery changes to Six Paths - Super Massive Rasen-Shuriken.

chases.name: Sage Art - Magnet Style Rasengan
chases.description: Chases and Attacks a Low Floated or Knocked Down unit, causes Repulse and Magnet Seal. This skill is unavoidable. If Naruto has Shukaku Resonance, this skill additionally ignores a certain amount of Defense and Resistance and Magnet Seal becomes a Special Effect.

passives.name: Six Paths - Multiple Tailed Beast Rasen-Shuriken
passives.description: After your lineup executes the first Mystery and Trigger in a round, Naruto executes Additional Skill: Tailed Beast Repeated Rasen-Shuriken to cause unavoidable damage, Interruption and Suppress Super Armor for 1 round to all units in the opponent's field.

passives.name: Power of Friendship
passives.description: Naruto has Power of Six Paths. Every time your lineup is attacked, dispels all Fear they currently have, increases their Standard Attack damage by 15% (stackable up to 6 times) and Jinchuriki ninjas in your lineup will have their Standard Attack becomes unavoidable, last until the end of the round.

passives.name: Power of Six Paths
passives.description: Passive: Naruto has Advanced Immunity and whenever he executes a Mystery skill, scale his Physical ATK by 12%. If Naruto activates Kokuo Resonance, executes Six Paths - Recovery (Trigger: Naruto resets his action count.) immediately and Six Paths - Restoration (Trigger: Naruto dispels all Debuffs (including Level 2 Debuffs), resets his action count and sets Tailed Beast Bond back to its initial state.) at the end of the round. Six Paths - Recovery and Six Paths - Restoration each recover 10% of Naruto's max HP.

passives.name: Kurama Chakra Cloak
passives.description: At the beginning of battle, Naruto grants Kurama Chakra to his entire lineup, increasing Physical ATK and Physical DEF by 50%, increasing Speed by 10% and granting 50% Life Steal for the battle. Life Steal restores HP based on actual damage dealt. This buff does not stack with another Naruto Final Battle.
